responses.ensemble_reason: KEEP SINGLE: Logistic Regression. It had the best mean AP across three forward folds (0.392, fold SD 0.030) and the best Brier (0.0633). No ensemble beat it: Weighted 0.389 (-0.002), Stack 0.383 (-0.009), Equal 0.372 (-0.020), so none cleared the gate of gaining more than one fold SD. The base models were highly correlated (0.88-0.96), so combining them had little to add. Stack also had the worst ECE (0.031) because it rescales probabilities. Weighted's 0.002 gap is noise, and three models cost more to run, monitor and explain, so the extra complexity did not earn its place.
responses.validation_limits: Candidates were compared with nested forward OOF on 2,155 rows across folds 2023Q1, 2023Q3 and 2024Q1: training always precedes validation with time for the 90-day outcome to mature, customers are separated, and ensemble weights and the stacker were learned on inner OOF only. Limits: the three folds share overlapping training histories, so fold SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval or significance test. The threshold was chosen on the same OOF labels, so its loss (1,111 units) is optimistic. The training data was used earlier in the course, so this is not a final untouched test, and challenge labels are unavailable.
responses.calibration_limits: The sigmoid was learned on a reserved calibration period (836 rows, 78 defaults) held out from training and selection. It did not improve calibration: Brier rose from 0.0765 to 0.0781, log-loss from 0.266 to 0.277 and ECE from 0.021 to 0.035, while AP and AUC were unchanged. The unweighted Logistic was likely already well calibrated, leaving little to correct. These are fit diagnostics on the same rows used to learn the sigmoid, not an independent evaluation, and no calibration claim can be made on the unlabeled challenge data.
responses.capacity_fairness: On OOF, the threshold 0.169 flagged 245 of 2,155 requests (11.4%; busiest period 11.7%), catching 84 of 179 defaulters (recall 46.9%, precision 34.3%). On the 2,500-request challenge batch, 330 requests (13.2%) exceeded the transported threshold, so the 12% cap kept the top 300 and removed 30, keeping tied scores together. Regional OOF FPR ranged from 6.3% (eastern) to 10.3% (western), about a 4-point gap, and western also had the lowest recall (44.7%), the same pattern as Day 3. With about 490 negatives and only 35-49 defaulters per region, this is descriptive and noisy, not a fairness certificate, but the repeated western pattern needs review.
responses.explanation_scope: Day 4 explanations belong to the Day 4 weighted LightGBM. The final model is an unweighted Logistic Regression with a different calibration, so those SHAP values and reason codes cannot be attributed to it. For the final version I would need to recheck feature contributions (coefficients or SHAP on this model), regenerate reason statements, repeat the local stability check and confirm whether bureau_score and dti still dominate.
responses.intended_use: Educational use only, on synthetic Tamweel Lite data, to practise validation, threshold policy and calibration. A decision of 1 is a simulated review flag; 0 is not an approval or a safety guarantee. It must not be used for real financing approval or refusal, for decisions about real people or regions, or as evidence of fairness.
responses.monitoring_plan: Track each batch's flag volume against the 12% cap, since the challenge batch already exceeded it before capping (13.2%). Monitor score distribution and prevalence for drift. Once 90-day outcomes mature, recheck AP, Brier and ECE and whether the sigmoid still helps or should be removed through a governed update. Recheck regional FPR and recall with their denominators, especially western. Any threshold or model change must be developed and validated on new data, not tuned on the batch being judged.
responses.executive_summary_ar: قارنت ثلاثة نماذج منفردة وثلاث طرق تجميع، واخترت الانحدار اللوجستي لأنه حقق أعلى AP (0.392) ولم يتجاوزه أي تجميع بفارق يفوق الانحراف بين الطيات (0.030). العتبة 0.169 تلتقط 46.9% من حالات التعثر ضمن سعة 12% في كل فترة. لم تحسّن معايرة sigmoid الاحتمالات لأن النموذج كان معايرًا أصلًا. في دفعة التحدي تجاوزت 330 حالة العتبة فاحتُفظ بأعلى 300 فقط. تحتاج فجوة المنطقة الغربية إلى مراجعة، والنتائج تعليمية على بيانات اصطناعية.
responses.executive_summary_en: I compared three single models and three ensembles and kept Logistic Regression: it had the best AP (0.392) and no ensemble beat it by more than the fold SD (0.030). The threshold 0.169 catches 46.9% of defaulters within 12% capacity in every period. Sigmoid calibration did not improve the probabilities, as the model was already well calibrated. On the challenge batch, 330 requests passed the threshold and the cap kept the top 300. The western-region gap needs review. All results are educational, on synthetic data.
